notes.title: DEMENTIUM II HD TRADING CARDS ARE NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Time to collect some twisted [i]Trading Cards[/i], form some bloody [i]Badges[/i] and earn some eerie [i]Emoticons[/i] as the [b]Dementium II HD Steam Trading Cards[/b] have just gone live!

There are 12 Trading cards in all ranging from a number of the demented creatures you face such as the toothy Chest Maws and bloated Slime-Mines as well as the weapons needed to take them down.  Keep collecting and earning badges from "Anxious" to full on "Psychosis" to show off how crazy you are about the game!  Play too long and you may need a full on lobotomy.

[url=https://fbcdn-sphotos-c-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-prn2/1554500_10152903538742281_1828479897_n.jpg]Here's a glimpse at some of the horrors you can unlock...[/url]

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Dementium II HD
notes.notes:
Dementium II HD is Now Available on Steam and 25% off.

The visage of doctors and patients alike fade in and out of these nightmarish visions of tortured memories. This eggshell reality is fractured by experiments conducted in the ward. Blood, flesh and screams surround as you put together the pieces of your story and make your escape from the Bright Dawn Treatment Center while the dark doctor watches on in amusement. You are William Redmoor and your life is about to become a living hell.

Dementium II HD is the resurrection of the award winning handheld cult favorite rebuilt with all the classic gameplay while providing updated visuals, lighting and refined controls. Same Bones. New Flesh.

*offer ends January 2nd at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: DEMENTIUM II HD AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]THE LONG-AWAITED DEMENTIUM II HD SPAWNS TODAY ON STEAM[/b] 
 
[i]RELIVE THE NIGHTMARE OF WILLIAM REDMOOR 
FOR THE FIRST TIME IN HIGH DEFINITION[/i]
 
DECEMBER 17, 2013 - Digital Tribe Games announced that Dementium II HD is being unleashed on Steam and other major digital distribution channels today. Spurred by popular demand from a devoted fanbase that first experienced the nightmarish world of William Redmoor on the Nintendo DS, the brand-new PC version of the cult classic launches at a special discounted price of $11.25 – a full 25% off the regular price.
 
This carefully crafted PC offering brings the tragic tale of loss, discovery and escape to a whole new audience of gamers in highly demented definition. Originally developed for the Nintendo DS by developer Renegade Kid, Dementium II quickly became a favorite of horror fans across the globe. Many of these fans pleaded for this technical marvel with a twisted story to get the big-screen treatment of a high-def PC game – and those demands were heard loud and clear by Digital Tribe Games. 
 
Dementium II HD brings an all-new visual experience to the classic core gameplay. It includes a rebuilt lighting system, updated 3D models, hi-res textures, enhanced audio and refined controls that were never possible in its original incarnation; same bones, new flesh!
 
“[i]We wanted to preserve the feel of the game; its soul[/i],” says Producer Joe de Lange from Memetic, Dementium II HD’s developer. “[i]The single biggest challenge was the fact that playing on the PC is a very different experience compared to playing on the DS. We spent a lot time working to get that balance right.[/i]”
 
[b]Dementium II HD Features Include:[/b]
[LIST]
[*]Steam Big Picture Mode with full controller support, Steam Achievements and Cloud Saves on Day 1
[*]Classic gameplay that balances action, exploration, story and puzzle elements into a single, unforgettable horror experience
[*]Hordes of unique, nightmarish enemies that require different strategies to defeat – plus ghostly new creatures that will chill you to the bone
[*]Twisted storyline that keeps you guessing throughout the entire game
[*]Multifunctional weapons to take out enemies and grant access to new areas
[/LIST]
